Sonny & Cher – All I Ever Need Is You

Artist: Sonny & Cher

Title: All I Ever Need Is You

Label: Kapp Records

Catalog Number: KS-3660

Format: Vinyl LP, Stereo

Released in 1972, All I Ever Need Is You marked Sonny & Cher's successful return to the charts and features the hit title track along with country-pop and soft rock favorites.

Includes

  • All I Ever Need Is You
  • A Cowboy's Work Is Never Done
  • More Today Than Yesterday
  • Crystal Clear / Muddy Waters
  • United We Stand
  • You Better Sit Down Kids
  • Somebody

A great addition for collectors of classic pop, country-pop, and 1970s television icons.
